projectContent.text:
Clonex is the Israeli version of Clonazepam (sold under the brand names Klonopin and Rivotril) manufactured by Teva Pharmaceutical. For those unfamiliar, it’s a medication used to help prevent and treat panic and anxiety. This design is a reaction to the polarised public and political atmosphere in present Israel.

The Hebrew typography means “Clonex for the people”, below it in fine trilingual type “for a better future”. The typography serves as the body of a Sabra figure holding a pill in one hand and a flower in the other.
